sourceEvidence.title: Product Design and Engineering Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Willingness and ability to personally design, build, modify, fabricate, test, troubleshoot, and evaluate prototypes and products.
* Education
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* ️ Experience
* Minimum of 7–10 years of mechanical engineering, product design, manufacturing engineering, or product development experience.
* Advanced SolidWorks experience with a demonstrated history of using SolidWorks as a primary product design and engineering tool.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing physical prototypes using 3D printing, CNC machining, fabrication, machining, forming, or other prototyping methods.
* Experience taking products from CAD concept through prototype fabrication, functional testing, design iteration, validation, and production.
* Prior experience leading engineering projects and/or engineering personnel.
* Strong experience developing physical consumer, automotive, powersports, recreational vehicle, industrial, or similar manufactured products.
* Demonstrated experience taking products from concept through design, prototype, testing, tooling, validation, and production.
* Strong mechanical design experience.
* Experience with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, casting, forging, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, welding, extrusion, or related processes.
* Experience developing engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, and bills of materials.

Product Design and Engineering Manager
**Location:** Keller, TX — Onsite
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, Typical Business Hours
* ️ Position Overview
The Product Design and Engineering Manager leads the Engineering and New Product Development functions for Turn 14 Powersports. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for managing a small engineering team while actively contributing to product design, development, testing, prototyping, problem-solving, and continuous product improvement.
